name: socialytics
description: Socialytics, Moburst's organic social intelligence tool. Every tool calls the Socialytics API (base URL https://rwouwxqggjjacbpbhqsn.supabase.co/functions/v1/api) with an API key in the Authorization header as a bearer token. Lists return { data, next_cursor }; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: socialytics_clients_list
tools.description: List the clients this key may see, with their brand, pillars, keywords, design, Sprout and competitor summaries, readiness and last report.

tools.name: socialytics_client_get
tools.description: One client with its Sprout profiles (names and networks), competitor sets with handles, and report schedules.

tools.name: socialytics_client_setup
tools.description: Whether the client is ready (brand identity, pillars, keywords, Sprout profile, confirmed competitors, approved design system, schedule) and what still needs fixing.

tools.name: socialytics_client_analytics
tools.description: Sprout performance for a client over a window (default: the last 30 days): totals, the previous window, changes, per profile, top posts. Answers 422 unprocessable when the client has no Sprout profile.

tools.name: socialytics_reports_list
tools.description: Social analysis reports: period, status, deck link, counts, metric changes, warnings.

tools.name: socialytics_report_get
tools.description: One social report with its analysis, content calendar, performance and trend summaries.

tools.name: socialytics_competitive_reports_list
tools.description: Competitive reports: period, status, deck link, totals, quality check.

tools.name: socialytics_competitive_report_get
tools.description: One competitive report with its executive summary, scorecard, gaps, teardown, breakdowns and per-company aggregates.

tools.name: socialytics_competitor_sets_list
tools.description: Competitor sets with their competitors and social handles.

tools.name: socialytics_competitor_set_get
tools.description: One competitor set.

tools.name: socialytics_posts_list
tools.description: Generated posts: copy, hashtags, format, media, approval state.

tools.name: socialytics_post_get
tools.description: One generated post.

tools.name: socialytics_media_jobs_list
tools.description: Media generation jobs with their status, output and review.

tools.name: socialytics_schedules_list
tools.description: Report schedules.

tools.name: socialytics_scheduled_posts_list
tools.description: Posts scheduled to Sprout Social.

tools.name: socialytics_alerts_list
tools.description: Competitive alerts: topics competitors are posting about.

tools.name: socialytics_design_systems_list
tools.description: Design systems with templates, tokens and previews.

tools.name: socialytics_status
tools.description: Pipeline health findings and demo job counts.

tools.name: socialytics_demo_create
tools.description: Onboard any brand from its name and website and run every Socialytics feature for it (brand identity, brief, pillars, design system when references exist, competitors with tracking, social and competitive reports, a generated post, analytics when a Sprout profile exists). Answers 202 with a job; poll socialytics_demo_get or give a callback_url. Takes 30 minutes to 3 hours.

tools.name: socialytics_demo_get
tools.description: Live progress of a demo job by step, and its outputs when complete.

tools.name: socialytics_demo_list
tools.description: Demo jobs.

tools.name: socialytics_demo_cancel
tools.description: Stop a queued or running demo job.

tools.name: socialytics_demo_discard
tools.description: Remove what a finished demo job created (the client when the job created it, otherwise only its competitor sets, reports, posts and media jobs).
